cohort: A total of 200 consenting women who delivered babies weighing >=3.5 kg were enrolled at a tertiary care Centre in South Gujarat.
finding: Deliveries involving neonates weighing >=3.5 kg are frequently associated with higher maternal BMI, diabetes, multiparity, increased risk of operative delivery, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Deliveries involving neonates weighing >=3.5 kg showed an increased risk of operative delivery, including Caesarean section, often due to suspected macrosomia, cephalopelvic disproportion, or fetal distress.
